title: Mannar residents demonstrate in Colombo against wind-farm and sand-mining plans
threshold_50_evidence: TamilWin reports more than 500 participants at the one Colombo gathering; published qualitative count exceeds 50.

occurrence.summary: TamilWin body reports a protest outside the Presidential Secretariat on 19 September.

date.summary: Byline dated 19 September 2025 and article states protest took place that day.

participants.summary: More than 500 residents from Mannar reported.

threshold.summary: Same-site report says more than 500 people protested; this supports >=50, without using the districtwide counts from other protests.

state_target.summary: Demonstration took place outside Presidential Secretariat and demanded halt to 14-turbine project and no mineral-sand mining permits.

demands.summary: Stop planned wind-tower project, prohibit mineral-sand permits and address harms from existing wind farms; coded land_farm_issue for land/resource use.

state_response.summary: No response described; all dimensions unknown.

notes: One opened Tamil-language local source establishes occurrence/count/demand; treat the count as reported, not independently corroborated.
open_questions: Independent local follow-up and episode relationship to sustained Mannar protest remain to review.

location.summary: Snippet says CEB headquarters in Colombo.

participants.summary: 10,000 are sick-leave participants across workforce, not at a gathering; protest-site count absent.

state_target.summary: Snippet relates action to government restructuring and employee demands, but body not read.

demands.summary: Restructuring, benefits and work conditions mentioned in search result; not body verified.

notes: Not eligible as verified; keep as a follow-up lead, not a countable event.
